nodes.label: .`no data gives an empty report with no zeros pretending to be facts`()
.`sessions without any structured receipts leave skips uncounted, not zero`()
.`an earlier window with nothing ended gives no delta rather than a delta from zero`()
.`a skip decided by an unreadable signal is UNKNOWN, never the signal's NO_MATCH family`()
.`when a real NO_MATCH decided the skip, an UNKNOWN alongside it is not blamed`()
.`rehearsals and duplicate callbacks are not skips of anything that happened`()
.`cleanup counts released in the window and never hides an old outstanding obligation`()
.`an outstanding obligation alone is enough for a report`()
.`needs attention counts a partial session once, however many things went wrong in it`()
.`blocked actions group by action and by what the record can say about the cause`()
.`the window includes its first instant and now, and excludes the instant before`()
.`a session older than two windows feeds neither the counts nor the delta`()
.`time in cues splits by end reason`()
.`per-routine stats carry median, top skip and whether the last run ended cleanly`()
.`spans and skip ticks carry local minute of day for the 24-hour chart`()
.`with no ledger at all, ledger-derived fields are null, not zero`()
.`a ledger with no gap events reports no gap time rather than zero gap time`()
.`recorded gaps over 30 percent of the coach window are reported as the coach suppressing conclusions`()
